title: Maximum overshadowing of an adjoining property (Table 3.9a)
text: In climate zones 4, 5, and 6, development is designed that its shadow cast at midday, 21 June (refer Figure 3.9a) onto any other adjoining property and/or diagonally adjacent lot (refer Figure 3.9b) does not exceed the limits set out in Table 3.9a.

exceptions.label: C3.9.2 single storey, wall height not more than 3.5 m
C3.9.3 narrow adjoining lot (R40+, frontage 7.5 m or less): Table 3.9b governs

replaces.note: percentages unchanged; R80+ adjoining now no maximum; diagonal lots now covered at R40 and below
'R50 or higher 50%' -> R50-R60 50%, R80+ no maximum

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Same as Chapter 2 C3.9.1. Shadow as % of the adjoining site area at NGL; dividing fences up to 2 m do not contribute (Figure 3.9c). Table 3.9a footnote 1 (p44): where the development adjoins a grouped dwelling development, the limit applies to each grouped dwelling site area excluding common property (Figure 3.9d); supply the adjoining percentage per dwelling site (adjoining.south.is_grouped_site flags it; not encoded). C3.9.2 (p45, ch3-084) also requires the single-storey building to meet C3.2.1, C3.4.1, C3.4.5, C3.4.6 and C3.1.1, and is unavailable where it is on the same lot as a two-storey building (catches mixed one/two-storey grouped schemes); only storeys and wall height are tested, building.storeys read as the tallest building on the lot. Named codes have no row (NOT_APPLICABLE). Coding excludes R100-SL: Chapter 3 Table 2.10a (p26) removes all 3.9 provisions for R100-SL, but its footnote restores them where the development abuts a property not coded R100-SL (not encoded).

verified.note: Table 3.9a and C3.9.2 checked on p44-45. C3.9.2 exception tests storeys and wall height only (the cross-referenced C3.2.1, C3.4.1, C3.4.5, C3.4.6, C3.1.1 and the same-lot two-storey proviso are not tested; exception keeps its own verify flag). Footnote 1 (per grouped dwelling site area) not encoded. Exception source strings cite p43 (the Chapter 2 page); the Chapter 3 page is 45, left unchanged (pairing signature).
